analysis.headline: Trump creates 'Super Intelligence Force' and names an AI czar
analysis.summary: Trump announced a new task force called the Super Intelligence Force, described as his latest response to the AI safety debate, and put an AI czar in charge of it. Separately, intelligence chief Jay Clayton was named the new White House AI czar.
